# Felipe IxD

> Interaction-design studio in Porto, Portugal, selling three fixed-price packages to software teams.

- Interface audit (one product flow): €1,200 — https://felipeixd.com/interface-audit.html
- Clickable prototype (one user flow): €2,400 — https://felipeixd.com/clickable-prototype.html
- Component sheet (up to 30 components): €3,200 — https://felipeixd.com/component-sheet.html
- Extra flow on an audit: €450
- How the studio works: https://felipeixd.com/how-the-studio-works.html
- Payment and refunds: https://felipeixd.com/payment-and-refunds.html
- Start a package: https://felipeixd.com/start-a-package.html

Design only: no software development, no hosting, no advertising work, no promised figures.
